hook: Seafloor landslides were caught on camera creeping slowly uphill, not collapsing all at once.
summary: This is the first direct monitoring of fully submarine landslides in nature, at the Homathko Delta in Canada. They retreated slowly upslope, the signature of breaching, and fed long-lasting turbidity currents that carry sediment and carbon offshore. Longer-lasting loads matter for seabed structures. The observations come from a single delta.
title: Direct monitoring of breaching in deltaic submarine landslides.
